subject: Air freight quote to MEX
body:
Hi,

Could you quote the fastest air freight option to MEX (Mexico City, MX), all-in in EUR? Please arrange trucking from our site in 64834 (Darmstadt), Germany, to the departure airport. The shipment is ready for pickup on 2026-11-26.

It’s laboratory glassware: 6 pieces, 1491 kg gross, 12.32 cbm.

Sara
Lindqvist Medtech
